wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Grace Tower |characters=グレースタワー |japanese=Grace Tower |image=Grace Tower.png |imagesize=250px |region=Kalos |epicode=XY054 |episode=Facing the Grand Design! }} '''Grace Tower''' (Japanese: '''グレースタワー''' ''Grace Tower'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]] that was featured in ''[[XY054|Facing the Grand Design!]]''. It is a rock formation located between [[Shalour City]] and [[Coumarine City]]. Near Grace Tower is a forest that is home to {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Malamar}}, {{p|Inkay}}, {{p|Ledyba}}, {{p|Bidoof}}, and {{p|Flabébé}}. The tower is rumored to be a landing site for {{wp|UFO}}s, something that aroused great excitement in {{Ash}} and {{an|Bonnie}} but skepticism in {{an|Clemont}} when {{ashfr|the group}} decided to explore the tower. The evil {{an|Malamar}} from ''[[XY019|A Conspiracy to Conquer!]]'', along with two others, tried to use the top of Grace Tower as the site for them to carry out their grand design - using massive amounts of energy generated by six strange devices in order to alter the world's environment. Ash, his friends, {{TRT}}, and [[Officer Jenny]], caught up to them to see what they were doing and try to stop them. The trio of evil Malamar managed to capture everyone except for {{an|Clemont}}, [[James]], and {{MTR}}, in which they escaped. Clemont, James, and Meowth returned to the Grace Tower with the help from the Malamar and Inkay they befriended in the forest. The forest Malamar and Inkay were able to free Ash, {{an|Serena}}, Bonnie, {{AP|Pikachu}}, [[Jessie]], {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}, and Officer Jenny from the evil Malamar's {{m|Psychic}}. Even though the three evil Malamar were defeated, they escaped with their devices and vowed to carry out their grand design someday.
